analysts_bullish_three_stocks.headline: Wall Street Analysts Bullish on UnitedHealth, Meta, and Marvell Stocks
analysts_bullish_three_stocks.summary: Despite AI trade tensions and oil price pressures, top analysts recommend UnitedHealth, Meta Platforms, and Marvell as high‑growth picks for long‑term investors.
highlights: UnitedHealth raised its 2026 EPS outlook to at least $20.50 and targets $23.17 EPS by 2027.
Meta’s Muse AI agent reached 1.3 million daily active users in five weeks, still under 0.05% of its 3.6 billion base.
Marvell expanded its total addressable market to $400 billion by 2030 and set a FY31 revenue goal of $30 billion.

draft_special_solar_power_installation_o.headline: Bangladesh Cabinet Approves Ordinance to Accelerate Rooftop Solar Installations
draft_special_solar_power_installation_o.summary: The cabinet gave final approval to a draft ordinance that creates a regulatory framework for rooftop solar projects, aiming to cut fossil fuel imports and subsidies.
highlights: Government targets 3,000‑4,000 MW of rooftop solar by next summer
Installations will use OPEX financing for public institutions and CAPEX options for revenue‑generating entities
Draft ordinance fills gaps in pricing, rent‑share and procurement rules

unlicensed_payment_platforms_flagged_22.headline: Bangladesh Bank flags 22 unlicensed payment platforms over fraud risks
unlicensed_payment_platforms_flagged_22.summary: Bangladesh Bank warned that unlicensed loan and payment apps steal personal data, expose borrowers to blackmail, and violate the Payment and Settlement Systems Act.
highlights: 22 platforms, including BohudurPay and ZiniPay, operate without Bangladesh Bank licences
Violations breach Section 15(2) and Section 37(1) of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2024

bank_share_price_upside_recommendations.headline: CAL Bangladesh Picks Five Banks with Up to 81% Share Upside
bank_share_price_upside_recommendations.summary: CAL Bangladesh recommends BRAC Bank, City Bank, Eastern Bank, Dutch‑Bangla Bank and Pubali Bank, forecasting up to 81% price gains as sector reforms boost credit expansion.
highlights: BRAC Bank target price Tk117.45 implies 80.7% upside
Median NPL ratio of Cycle‑Ready banks is 3.8% versus sector 32.8%
Regulatory cap limits weighted‑average lending‑deposit spreads to 4%

starlink_restriction_warning.headline: Bessent cautions Zelenskyy on claims of U.S. Starlink slowdown
starlink_restriction_warning.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned President Zelenskyy to avoid unverified accusations that the United States is throttling the military Starlink service, Starshield, amid ongoing restrictions.
highlights: Starshield, the government‑controlled version of SpaceX’s Starlink, has faced speed limits imposed by the U.S. military.
President Trump denied any involvement in the slowdown, despite White House orders reportedly restricting the technology.
U.S. lawmakers criticized Trump’s waiver of sanctions while he promoted importing Russian diesel to lower fuel prices.

weekly_stock_market_preview.headline: Earnings Week Ahead: Capital One, Meta, and AI Chip Makers in Focus
weekly_stock_market_preview.summary: This week’s earnings season spotlights Capital One’s credit outlook, Meta’s AI-driven growth, and key semiconductor reports amid rising bond yields and inflation pressures.
highlights: Capital One expected EPS $5.50 on $16.26 billion revenue, with focus on net interest margin and charge‑offs.
Meta projected EPS $5.94 on $63.32 billion revenue, emphasizing AI platform Muse and user engagement metrics.
Semiconductor makers Lam Research and Texas Instruments report, offering insight into AI buildout and supply‑demand balance.

bangladesh_japan_sign_employment_skills_.institution: Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment
bangladesh_japan_sign_employment_skills_.headline: Bangladesh and Japan Sign Employment Skills Deal, Recruitment Starts 2027
bangladesh_japan_sign_employment_skills_.summary: The new Memorandum of Cooperation on Employment Skills Development will allow Bangladeshi workers to be recruited to Japan from April 2027, offering legal protection and skill‑building opportunities.
highlights: Recruitment of Bangladeshi workers to Japan begins on 1 April 2027 under a ten‑year agreement.
The deal guarantees equal legal protection for Bangladeshi migrants, including safeguards against gender‑based dismissal.
The agreement was signed by Bangladesh’s Ministry of Expatriates’ Welfare and Overseas Employment and multiple Japanese

dsex_edges_down_as_sell_off_continues_fo.headline: DSEX slips as sell‑off persists into second session
dsex_edges_down_as_sell_off_continues_fo.summary: The DSEX fell to 5,422 as turnover dropped to Tk365 crore, with investors cautious amid earnings disclosures and technical disruptions on the DSE.
highlights: Blue‑chip DS30 index slipped 4 points to 2,085
Textiles led turnover with a 23% share

bsec_closes_proceedings_against_investor.headline: BSEC Drops Enforcement Case Against Investor Zhuang Lifefeng
bsec_closes_proceedings_against_investor.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission dismissed proceedings against investor Zhuang Lifeng, while simultaneously fining CBC Capital and related parties for series trading and price manipulation.
highlights: Zhuang held a Beneficiary Owner account with Prime Bank Securities and appeared at a hearing on 20 April.
CBC Capital and affiliates were fined a total of Tk35.92 lakh for manipulating shares of Taufika Foods and Lovello Ice‑Cream PLC.

india_s_finance_minister_says_easy_exits.headline: India Finance Minister Blames Easy Liquidity for Equity Market Underperformance
india_s_finance_minister_says_easy_exits.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman warned that abundant liquidity and easy exits are driving a near‑12% slump in Indian equities despite solid economic fundamentals.
highlights: Benchmark indexes have fallen almost 12% since January, per LSEG data.
Foreign investors have sold over $33 billion of direct Indian equities this year.
Domestic mutual funds have logged net inflows every month since March 2021.

indonesian_stocks_plunge_to_six_year_low.headline: Indonesian Stocks Plunge Over 5% Amid MSCI Downgrade Fears
indonesian_stocks_plunge_to_six_year_low.summary: Indonesia's benchmark index fell to a six‑year low as MSCI's possible reclassification sparks fears of $5.6 billion passive fund outflows and further foreign investor withdrawals.
highlights: MSCI may move Indonesia from emerging‑market to stand‑alone status, with a final decision due by June.
Goldman Sachs estimates up to $5.6 billion could exit passive funds if MSCI removes Indonesia, with an additional $2.7 billion
Foreign ownership of Indonesian equities fell to 25% in October, down from 27% in January, halving the value of holdings to

france_hit_by_worst_unrest_in_years_as_a.headline: France Faces Violent Unrest Over Budget Cuts and Rising Living Costs
france_hit_by_worst_unrest_in_years_as_a.summary: Mass protests erupted across France as the government seeks €54 billion in savings, sparking riots, arrests and a deadly clash over high living costs.
highlights: Nearly 2,400 people were arrested and about 1,000 police injured.
The budget aims to trim €54 billion to reduce a debt of €3.6 trillion, 119% of GDP.

energy_crisis_cushion.headline: Bangladesh Finance Minister Seeks Two-Year Cushion to Tackle Energy Crisis
energy_crisis_cushion.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khasru Mahmud Chowdhury requested a two‑year buffer to address the gas shortage, expand LNG infrastructure and stabilize the economy amid global fallout.
highlights: Bangladesh has incurred $7 billion in out‑of‑pocket energy costs and plans to drill 150 wells through state‑owned Bapex.
The government aims to add 10 GW of solar capacity and develop three to four floating storage and regasification units within

middle_east_energy_costs.headline: Middle East Crisis Adds $4.12 Billion to Bangladesh Energy Costs, Gov't Pushes Matarbari Hub
middle_east_energy_costs.summary: The ongoing Middle East crisis has raised Bangladesh’s energy expenses by $4.12 billion in eight months, while officials promote a new regional hub.
highlights: Energy sector faces $4.12 billion added cost over eight months due to Middle East tensions
Government aims to develop Matarbari into a regional energy hub
BGMEA launches ESG platform to boost garment export competitiveness

interim_dividend.headline: LafargeHolcim Announces 10% Interim Dividend Amid Profit Decline
interim_dividend.summary: LafargeHolcim Bangladesh posted a 21% drop in net profit for the first nine months despite a 6% sales rise, yet declared a 10% interim cash dividend.
highlights: Operating EBIT fell 19% year‑on‑year to Tk349 crore.
Geocycle co‑processed over 31,000 tonnes of waste, achieving a 10% fossil fuel replacement rate.

yen_interest_rate.headline: Japan PM Takaichi Defends Yen Policy Amid Rising Bond Yields
yen_interest_rate.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi rejected criticism linking her to the weak yen and higher interest rates, pledging to boost confidence while managing government bond issuance.
highlights: Yields on Japanese government bonds have reached multi‑decade highs as the central bank raises policy rates.
The yen fell to its lowest level since 1986, prompting intervention from Tokyo and Washington.

public_benefit_fund.headline: Anthropic Allocates 5% Shares to New AI Job‑Disruption Fund
public_benefit_fund.summary: Anthropic will commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit LLC, with potential increases tied to valuation growth, to address AI‑driven job disruption.
highlights: Fund initially holds 5% of Anthropic shares and may rise by 2% for each 50% valuation increase.
Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion ahead of a planned November IPO.
The fund is structured as an LLC, not a 501(c)(3), and equity will not be used for lobbying.

data_center_energy.headline: Google Partners with Xcel Energy to Finance Cleaner AI Data Center
data_center_energy.summary: Google will fund 1,400 MW of wind, 200 MW of solar and 300 MW of battery storage for Xcel’s grid, powering its 780‑MW AI data center with carbon‑free energy by 2030.
highlights: Google commits to pay at least 75% of contracted capacity even if it uses less
The agreement adds more renewable capacity than the data center’s consumption, benefiting all local Xcel customers
Approval pending from the Minnesota Public Utilities Commission

direct_listing_rules.headline: BSEC Tightens Direct Listing Rules, Extends Price Discovery to Two Hours
direct_listing_rules.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission raised turnover thresholds, set minimum asking prices 25% below reference, and extended first‑day price discovery to two hours.
highlights: Minimum net worth for banks, financial institutions and insurers increased to Tk500 crore.
Annual turnover requirement for large firms raised to Tk1,000 crore and commercial operation period extended to five years.
Asking price must be at least 25% below reference price and backed by two valuation methods.

commodity_derivatives_licence.headline: Bangladesh BSEC approves six brokers for commodity derivatives licence
commodity_derivatives_licence.summary: The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission gave in‑principle approval to six brokerage firms to become commodity derivatives brokers, paving the way for the country's first exchange.
highlights: The approved firms are Sohel Securities Limited, Island Securities Limited, NLI Securities Limited, Be Rich Limited, PHP Stocks
The Chittagong Stock Exchange plans to launch futures contracts for gold, silver and crude palm oil as the initial products.
The exchange will later enable farmers to hedge rice and wheat prices months before harvest.

kokil_textile_ppp.headline: Bangladesh Approves PPP Revitalization of Kokil Textile Mill in Brahmanbaria
kokil_textile_ppp.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs gave in‑principle approval to redevelop the long‑idle Kokil Textile Mills under a public‑private partnership.
highlights: The project will be implemented through Bangladesh Textile Mills Corporation (BTMC).
Previous private owners left unpaid dues of Tk 33.84 crore.

fi_2027_postponement.headline: Saudi Postpones Future Investment Initiative to 2027 Amid Houthi Attacks
fi_2027_postponement.summary: Saudi Arabia delayed its flagship Future Investment Initiative conference to 2027 after escalating Houthi missile and drone attacks threatened the safety of participants.
highlights: The original event was set for Oct. 26‑29 in Riyadh.
Prominent speakers included Jamie Dimon, David Solomon, Stephen Schwarzman, Larry Fink and Jane Fraser.
Saudi military intercepted drones and missiles targeting Riyadh and the Red Sea port of Yanbu.

fr_market_stress.headline: French Unrest Fuels Debt Crisis Fears, Markets Slide
fr_market_stress.summary: Political turmoil and rising bond yields have pushed the euro, CAC 40 and French OATs lower, intensifying concerns over France’s fiscal outlook.
highlights: 10-year OAT yield rose over 10 basis points, nearing its highest level in decades
Overseas investors now hold nearly 60% of French debt, up from 48% in 2022
The OAT‑Bund spread hit its widest since the early‑2010s sovereign debt crisis

jpm_defense_5b.headline: JPMorgan Chase Deploys $5 Billion in Defense Startup Investments
jpm_defense_5b.summary: JPMorgan Chase has poured $5 billion into early‑stage defense, manufacturing and supply‑chain startups, signaling a rapid shift toward securing U.S. strategic industries.
highlights: The bank led a $1.4 billion round for Hadrian, which operates factories with ten robots per worker.
JPMorgan backed Castelion’s low‑cost hypersonic missile “Blackbeard” in a $1 billion funding round.
The initiative aims to reach $1.5 trillion in security‑related financing over ten years.

vat_target_15_by_2030_imf_condition.headline: Bangladesh Aims for Uniform 15% VAT by 2030 to Satisfy IMF
vat_target_15_by_2030_imf_condition.summary: Bangladesh plans to phase out over 500 VAT exemptions and adopt a single 15% rate by 2030, meeting IMF loan conditions while retaining essential item exemptions.

battery_storage_for_apparel_energy_crisi.headline: Battery Storage Offers Fast Relief for Bangladesh Apparel Energy Crisis
battery_storage_for_apparel_energy_crisi.summary: Bangladesh’s garment sector faces up to 30% output loss from power shortages, but financing affordable battery energy storage systems could restore stability within months.

china_exim_bank_invest_bangladesh_trade_.headline: China Exim Bank and Invest Bangladesh Push Chinese Banks into Bangladesh
china_exim_bank_invest_bangladesh_trade_.summary: Bangladesh Bank and Invest Bangladesh hosted a Beijing event showcasing $19 billion trade, urging Chinese banks to set up local operations and finance priority sectors.
highlights: Eleven Chinese banks attended the Bangladesh Day event in Beijing
Bangladesh‑China trade reached $19 billion in FY2025
China Exim Bank has nearly 40 projects across infrastructure, energy and agriculture in Bangladesh

bangladesh_japan_pm_level_talks_tokyo_27.institution: Government of Bangladesh / Government of Japan

bangladesh_japan_pm_level_talks_tokyo_27.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will meet Japan’s Sanae Takaichi in Tokyo to deepen economic ties, sign MoUs and boost Japanese investment under the 2026 EPA.

relaxed_experience_requirement_md_appoin.headline: Bangladesh Relaxes Experience Rule for State Bank Managing Director Appointments
relaxed_experience_requirement_md_appoin.summary: The government now permits candidates without two years as deputy managing directors to be considered for MD or CEO roles, provided they meet qualifications and leadership criteria.
highlights: The new policy still requires at least 20 years banking experience and a postgraduate degree.
Appointments need selection committee recommendation, ACC report, prime minister approval, and Bangladesh Bank consent.

copper_outshines_gold.headline: Copper Outshines Gold as AI, Defense Drive Strategic Demand
copper_outshines_gold.summary: Copper has surged 15.8% YTD, outpacing gold, as AI infrastructure, power‑grid upgrades and defense spending create inelastic demand despite tariff uncertainty.

A potential 15% U.S. tariff on refined copper and low Chinese inventories add supply risk.

treasury_yields_lower.headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Slip Ahead of Fed Rate Decision and Housing Data
treasury_yields_lower.summary: Treasury yields edged lower on Tuesday as markets awaited September housing starts, pending sales, and the Federal Reserve’s upcoming rate verdict.

hsbc_ai_data_center_warning.headline: HSBC CEO cautions AI boom won’t make all data centers viable

pm_launches_tk12cr_incentive_programme_f.headline: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman launches Tk12 crore incentive for Rajshahi sugarcane farmers

pioneer_insurance_post_40_surges_in_prof.headline: Pioneer Insurance Posts 40% Profit Surge in First Nine Months

Gross premium income grew to Tk263.49 crore, net premium income to Tk130.67 crore.

no_other_country_matches_bangladesh_in_c.headline: Bangladesh Seeks EU Free Trade Deal Ahead of LDC Graduation Delay
no_other_country_matches_bangladesh_in_c.summary: Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir announced a three‑year postponement of Bangladesh’s LDC graduation and aims to seal an EU free‑trade agreement before the exit.

debt_deal_40b.headline: Options Traders Anticipate Modest Move Ahead of SpaceX After‑Hours Earnings

deepseek_ban.headline: U.S. Bans Chinese AI Firm DeepSeek from Federal Civilian Agencies
deepseek_ban.summary: The Trump administration ordered all civilian federal agencies to remove DeepSeek technology, citing security risks and potential data transfer to China.
highlights: Department of Homeland Security issued the order affecting Treasury, State and Justice departments

cpa_disputes_nbr_study_on_11_day_cargo_c.institution: Chittagong Port Authority / National Board of Revenue

dry_cell_battery_maker_quasem_industries.headline: Quasem Industries Announces 10% Dividend Amid Asset Surge

btrc_plans_to_phase_out_2g_networks_by_d.headline: BTRC to Shut Down 2G Networks by Dec 2029, Phase‑out Plan Unveiled

housing_rate_hike_risk.headline: Fed Faces Housing Slump as Mortgage Rates Near 7.6% Amid Inflation Fight
housing_rate_hike_risk.summary: Rising mortgage rates above 7% are deepening a housing market decline, complicating the Federal Reserve’s effort to curb inflation.
highlights: Pending sales index fell 7.3% in September, its lowest since 2001
Private housing starts dropped to a 5.2% annualized rate, far below expectations
Mortgage rates hovered around 7.6%, up from 3% five years ago

sep_housing_freeze.headline: September Mortgage Rate Surge Deepens U.S. Housing Market Freeze
sep_housing_freeze.summary: Rising mortgage rates pushed pending home sales down 7.3% month‑over‑month and 11.3% year‑over‑year, while construction starts fell to their lowest since September 2025.

solar_theft_ordinance.summary: The new Special Solar Power Installation Ordinance imposes up to three years jail and fines for theft, while damage carries up to five years, aiming to boost investment.

Zero points for economics, finance and monitoring implementation

oil_price_climb_middle_east.headline: Oil Prices Rise Amid Middle East Tensions and Shipping Cost Surge
oil_price_climb_middle_east.summary: Brent crude jumped to $110.13 and WTI to $98.92 as attacks on tankers and Saudi facilities heightened supply concerns and freight rates surged.
highlights: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards reported naval mines halted three tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi militants claimed strikes on Saudi Aramco’s Yanbu plant, Shaybah oilfield, and Riyadh and Abha airports.
Goldman Sachs says war‑risk premiums added about $7 to the $20 per barrel rise in average crude freight rates.

profit_outlook_slash_fuel_prices.headline: United Airlines Cuts 2026 Profit Outlook Amid Rising Fuel Costs
profit_outlook_slash_fuel_prices.summary: United Airlines lowered its 2026 earnings forecast to $7.22 per share as fuel prices jump to $4.80 per gallon, yet passenger bookings rose over 2%.
highlights: Adjusted EPS was $2.54 versus $2.57 expected
Fuel bill rose 62% to $4.84 billion
Revenue grew 17.4% to $17.88 billion

exports_miss_september.headline: Japan September Exports Rise 16.7% Yet Miss Forecasts
exports_miss_september.summary: Japan's September exports grew 16.7% year‑on‑year, driven by semiconductor and machinery shipments, but fell short of the 20.1% forecast.
highlights: Exports to the United States jumped 22.9%
Petroleum imports surged 51.1% with U.S. shipments up nearly 820%

rooppur_uranium_shipment_2026_10_21.headline: Third Uranium Shipment Arrives at Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant Under Tight Security
rooppur_uranium_shipment_2026_10_21.summary: The third batch of uranium fuel for Rooppur's first unit reached the plant in Ishwardi on October 21, escorted by army, SSF and police forces.
highlights: The convoy entered the plant premises at 10:03 am after departing the airport at 4:56 am.
Bangladesh Atomic Energy Regulatory Authority officials received the shipment upon arrival.
Security was coordinated by the Bangladesh Army, Special Security Force, police and intelligence agencies along the route.

bnp_first_solar_power_2026_10_21.headline: Bangladesh's BNP Office Launches First Party Rooftop Solar Power System
bnp_first_solar_power_2026_10_21.summary: State Minister Anindya Islam Amit inaugurated a 2kW rooftop solar system at Jashore BNP office to meet demand and feed surplus electricity into the grid via net metering.
highlights: The 2kW system can be expanded to 6kW through the inverter.
Surplus power will be sold to the national grid under a net‑metering arrangement.
The office expects to recover its investment in about three and a half years.

nighttime_heat_stress_productivity_2026_.headline: Nighttime Heat Stress Threatens Bangladesh’s Workers and Economy
nighttime_heat_stress_productivity_2026_.summary: Rising nocturnal heat in Dhaka is cutting informal workers’ wages by Tk50,630 crore annually, exposing health risks and prompting calls for stronger labor protections.
highlights: Dhaka stays 2.5‑5 °C hotter than rural areas after midnight.
Bangladesh’s heatwave warnings ignore nighttime temperatures and humidity, missing the peak stress period.

u_s_eyes_refining_muscle_of_indian_billi.headline: U.S. Seeks Reliance’s Refining Muscle as Rubio Visits Jamnagar Plant
u_s_eyes_refining_muscle_of_indian_billi.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio met Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance Industries in Jamnagar to discuss expanding U.S.‑India crude offtake, especially Venezuelan oil, amid rising diesel prices.
highlights: Jamnagar refinery processes 1.4 million barrels per day, the world’s largest single‑site capacity.
Reliance is the biggest non‑U.S. buyer of Venezuelan crude as of September.
Trump touted a potential $300 billion U.S. refinery investment linked to Reliance.

house_committee_says_webull_messages_poi.institution: U.S. House Select Committee on China
house_committee_says_webull_messages_poi.headline: House Committee Finds Webull Employee Accessed U.S. Customer Data from China
house_committee_says_webull_messages_poi.summary: Internal Microsoft Teams messages reveal a Webull employee in China accessed a U.S. customer account, contradicting the firm’s claim that data stays solely in the United States.
highlights: Webull’s shares fell over 19% after the committee’s October 7 report.
The messages date to 2021 and show a China‑based team member approving the account.

capital_one_s_strong_quarter_and_progres.headline: Capital One Beats Estimates on Strong Net Interest Income and Discover Synergies
capital_one_s_strong_quarter_and_progres.summary: Capital One reported a 6.4% revenue rise and 12% EPS growth, driven by higher net interest income and advancing Discover integration.
highlights: Net interest income rose about 4% quarter over quarter, exceeding estimates by $134 million.
Discover network fees grew 3.5% sequentially, boosting fee revenue to $2.34 billion.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/3-tourists-drown-.headline: Three Tourists Drown, Two Missing After Strong Currents Sweep Himchari Beach
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/3-tourists-drown-.summary: Three tourists drowned and two remain missing after strong currents swept them away while swimming at Himchari beach in Cox’s Bazar, prompting rescue operations.
highlights: Strong currents at Himchari beach caused five tourists to enter dangerous water
Lifeguards and Fire Service launched rescue operations; one survivor in critical condition taken to Cox’s Bazar Sadar Hospital
Incident occurred near the museum adjacent to Himchari Marina Resort around 5:30pm

tbsnews.net/worldbiz/europe/macron-conde.headline: Macron denounces Trump’s migrant claims while sealing Gulf diesel deals
tbsnews.net/worldbiz/europe/macron-conde.summary: During a Gulf tour, Macron condemned false migrant accusations and secured over 295,000 tonnes of diesel for France amid an energy crisis.
highlights: Macron called Trump’s statements "stupid" and "unacceptable"
France obtained 100,000 tonnes of diesel each from the UAE and Bahrain
The deal adds more than 10% to France’s monthly diesel consumption

tbsnews.net/worldbiz/europe/frances-macr.headline: France’s Macron Vows to Prevent Repeat of Yellow Vest Riots Amid Rising Borrowing Costs
tbsnews.net/worldbiz/europe/frances-macr.summary: President Macron pledged tighter security for upcoming Paris protests as French 10‑year bond yields climb to 5%, reflecting investor worries over fiscal stability.
highlights: Macron announced extra police and troops for Saturday’s Paris march
Benchmark 10‑year French bond yields hit 5%, their highest since 2002

openai_chatgptads_26countries_20261021.headline: OpenAI Rolls Out ChatGPT Ads to 26 New Countries
openai_chatgptads_26countries_20261021.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT Ads service to 26 additional nations, bringing the platform to 89 countries and targeting both free users and Go subscribers.
highlights: Ads will appear for free users and Go subscribers in markets such as Argentina, Peru, Nigeria, South Africa and Ukraine.
OpenAI’s ad revenue reached a $1 billion annualized run rate in August, up from $100 million in March.
Over 100,000 advertisers have already run campaigns on ChatGPT.

tokenizedstocks_overseas_20261021.headline: Tokenized Stock Trading Booms Abroad as US Giants Object
tokenizedstocks_overseas_20261021.summary: Tokenized equities volume surged to $11.31 billion in September, while firms like Goldman Sachs and Microsoft object to US tokenized share listings on platform.
highlights: Robinhood Chain tokenized stock volume jumped from $526 million to $11.31 billion within three months
Sixteen companies, including Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Alphabet and Caterpillar, have formally objected to trading their shares
Tokenized equities are now the fastest‑growing category on Solana, with non‑crypto markets making up 36.5% of Hyperliquid’s

nebius_aipricerise_20261021.headline: Nebius Says AI Computing Prices Surge Amid Neocloud Scrutiny
nebius_aipricerise_20261021.summary: Nebius reports AI computing prices rising faster than expected, while investors question neocloud business models and debt levels across the sector.
highlights: Nebius sees price per megawatt climbing and expects its 2027 capacity to sell out quickly
CoreWeave’s borrowing costs spiked, prompting debt concerns for other neocloud firms
SpaceX AI revenue jump to $7.56 billion lifts related cloud stocks

fdrs_stable_forex_buoy_desco_against_los.headline: Desco Returns to Profit on FDR Gains Amid Stable Forex
fdrs_stable_forex_buoy_desco_against_los.summary: State-owned Desco posted a Tk44 crore profit in FY26, driven by higher FDR interest income and a foreign‑exchange gain as the taka remained stable.
highlights: FDR investments total over Tk750 crore, but Tk114.48 crore are lodged in distressed banks.
Distribution revenue fell 1% despite a 6% rise in electricity volume.

bangladeshis_spending_nearly_four_times_.headline: Bangladeshis Spend Nearly Four Times More Abroad Than Foreigners Spend Locally via Cards
bangladeshis_spending_nearly_four_times_.summary: In August, Bangladeshis' card transactions abroad hit Tk987 crore, almost four times the Tk249 crore spent by foreign visitors inside Bangladesh.
highlights: Outbound spending split: Tk504.60 crore credit cards, Tk422.10 crore debit cards, Tk60.10 crore prepaid cards.
United States led credit card destinations with 17.16% share; United Kingdom led debit with 14.19%; India led prepaid with 18.71%.

biogasplantexpansion.headline: Bangladesh to Deploy Biogas Plants to Remote Areas Within Two Years
biogasplantexpansion.summary: The government plans to expand sustainable biogas technology to grassroots levels, aiming to install plants in remote regions within two years while supporting commercial production.
highlights: Action plan to spread biogas plants to remote areas within two years
Two farmers received Tk1.5 lakh soft‑term loans to install biogas units
Ministry will distribute a booklet on biogas benefits and modernise youth training

resumptionofdammamflights.headline: Biman Resumes Dammam Flights and Schedules Riyadh Service for Late October
resumptionofdammamflights.summary: Biman Bangladesh Airlines reinstated daily Dammam flights and added a Riyadh departure on 26 October as Saudi airport attacks subside.
highlights: Daily Dammam flights using Boeing 777 operate until 26 October
Riyadh flight departs Dhaka at 1:25 am on 26 October
Medina service continues with Boeing 787 unchanged

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/worst-people-beco.headline: Speaker Blames Social Decay for Corrupt MPs and Ministers in Bangladesh
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/worst-people-beco.summary: Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed warned that Bangladesh’s deteriorating social system enables corrupt individuals to become MPs and ministers, contrasting it with Ethiopia’s low crime rates.
highlights: Speaker Major (retd) Hafiz Uddin Ahmed criticized the Awami League for oppression and alleged asset flight abroad
He cited Ethiopia’s security‑free homes as evidence of better social order

oil_price_spike_mid_east_conflict.headline: Oil Prices Surge Amid Middle East Tensions and US Plans for Iran Strikes
oil_price_spike_mid_east_conflict.summary: Oil prices jumped as the United States and Israel prepare possible renewed strikes on Iran, raising concerns of further Middle East escalation.
highlights: Brent crude futures rose 1.71% to $110.67 a barrel
U.S. West Texas Intermediate climbed 1.42% to $98.53
U.S. ordered non‑emergency staff and families to leave Saudi Arabia

us_diplomats_saudi_pullout.headline: U.S. Evacuates Diplomats from Saudi Amid Plans for Iran Strikes
us_diplomats_saudi_pullout.summary: The United States ordered non‑emergency staff and families to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks rise and U.S.–Israeli forces ready a short, intensive strike on Iran.
highlights: U.S. State Department limited the evacuation order to Saudi Arabia despite broader regional security concerns.
Planning includes a short but intensive operation targeting Iran’s energy, nuclear and missile assets, coordinated with Israeli
Brent crude hovered above $110 per barrel as Chinese refiners seek alternative Middle‑Eastern supply amid reduced Iranian cargoes.

profit_forecast_cut_fuel_prices.headline: Southwest Airlines Slashes 2026 Profit Forecast Amid Rising Fuel Costs
profit_forecast_cut_fuel_prices.summary: Southwest Airlines cut its 2026 earnings outlook to $2.60‑$2.85 per share, citing higher fuel prices, while reporting strong demand and a 27% fare increase.
highlights: Adjusted EPS of 66 cents beat LSEG estimate of 58 cents
Revenue rose to $8.42 billion, up over 21% year‑over‑year
Capacity growth expected up to 4% year over year

weak_sales_dhaka_market.headline: Dhaka Clothing Retailers See Sales Slump Despite Up to 70% Discounts
weak_sales_dhaka_market.summary: Retailers across Dhaka markets reported sales falling to one‑third of normal levels during Durga Puja, even with discounts ranging from 20% to 70%.
highlights: Mens World offered a flat 20% discount on summer apparel, yet sales remained low.
Winter clothing arrivals have not boosted demand as temperatures stay mild.

sugarcane_incentive_controversy.headline: BNP MP Abu Sayed Chad Accepts Tk12,500 Sugarcane Incentive Amid Criticism
sugarcane_incentive_controversy.summary: BNP lawmaker Abu Sayed Chad received a Tk12,500 government incentive for sugarcane farming, sparking accusations of political favouritism despite claims of automatic selection.
highlights: The incentive is part of a Tk12 crore package for 38,970 growers across 15 sugar mill zones.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman disbursed funds electronically at a public rally in Rajshahi on 20 October.
Mill officials say recipients were chosen by a computer‑generated alphabetical list, not political selection.

ai_job_cuts_5k.headline: Barclays to Cut 5,000 Jobs in AI‑Driven Cost‑Saving Drive
ai_job_cuts_5k.summary: Barclays announced a 5% workforce reduction, cutting about 5,000 roles, as AI and automation aim to lower fixed costs after a profit rise but weaker trading.
highlights: Third‑quarter profit reached £2.3 billion, up 12% year‑on‑year.
Around 60% of cuts target support functions such as developers.

5000_job_cuts_ai_efficiency_2026.headline: Barclays to Cut 5,000 Jobs in AI‑Driven Efficiency Push
5000_job_cuts_ai_efficiency_2026.summary: Barclays announced a 5% workforce reduction, targeting 5,000 roles mainly in support functions, as AI technology drives organisational simplification and cost efficiency.
highlights: Pre‑tax profit rose 12% to £2.3 billion in Q3
CET1 capital ratio slipped to 14.2%

csi300_bear_market_10_week_rout_2026.headline: China's CSI 300 Falls Into Bear Market as Sell‑off Extends
csi300_bear_market_10_week_rout_2026.summary: The CSI 300 index slipped below its 20% decline threshold, marking ten weeks of losses amid structural overcapacity, weak profits and retail‑driven volatility.
highlights: CSI 300 down 20% from its June peak, extending a ten‑week decline
Retail investors drive about 90% of daily Chinese trading, heightening market volatility
Analysts cite excess capacity, a slowing property sector and weak consumer demand as key pressures

rate_hold_housing_supply_2026.headline: Bank of Korea Holds Rate at 3% Amid Housing Supply Push
rate_hold_housing_supply_2026.summary: South Korea's central bank kept its policy rate at 3% as inflation remains high, while President Lee urges an all‑out effort to increase housing supply.
highlights: The BOK cited rising uncertainties from the Middle East conflict and global monetary policies.
Housing‑related loans and Seoul area home price growth accelerated again.

pm_inspects_mongla_port_and_proposed_eco.headline: PM Tarique Rahman Inspects Mongla Port and Proposed Economic Zone
pm_inspects_mongla_port_and_proposed_eco.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s visit to Mongla Port, the Sundarbans and the planned economic zone sparked hopes for investment, infrastructure upgrades and job creation in southwestern Bangladesh.
highlights: Local businesses urged dredging and jetty improvements at Mongla Port.
Authorities plan a floating storage regasification unit (FSRU) LNG terminal to boost regional trade.

algeria_bangladesh_mou_on_energy_coopera.institution: Bangladesh Ministry of Power, Energy & Mineral Resources
algeria_bangladesh_mou_on_energy_coopera.headline: Bangladesh-Algeria MoU Boosts LNG Imports and Energy Infrastructure
algeria_bangladesh_mou_on_energy_coopera.summary: Bangladesh and Algeria signed a hydrocarbon MoU to secure LNG, LPG and petroleum imports while launching joint refinery and infrastructure projects to meet Bangladesh's energy demand.
highlights: MoU enables government-to-government LNG, LPG and petroleum imports from Algeria
Joint development of refineries and LNG infrastructure in Bangladesh is planned
Algerian Petroleum Institute will train Bangladeshi engineers in energy technologies

bsec_plans_unified_real_time_monitoring_.headline: BSEC Pushes Unified Back‑Office Software to Safeguard Investors' Money and Shares
bsec_plans_unified_real_time_monitoring_.summary: BSEC’s feasibility study aims to implement a real‑time monitoring system for brokerage houses, linking bank balances, client accounts and depository records to curb embezzlement.
highlights: BSEC plans a unified back‑office platform to reconcile brokerage banks with client consolidated accounts
Six brokerage firms allegedly misappropriated Tk608 cr, prompting compensation claims exceeding Tk250 cr
Implementation challenges include high costs, data migration and cybersecurity safeguards

jobless_claims_low_1960s.headline: U.S. Jobless Claims Near Six-Decade Low as Labor Market Holds Steady
jobless_claims_low_1960s.summary: Initial unemployment filings fell to 194,000, the lowest level since the 1960s, indicating a resilient labor market despite weak hiring and modest payroll growth.
highlights: Four‑week moving average of claims dropped to 197,750.
Layoff rate fell to 1% of the workforce over the past year.

largest_wealth_fund_30b_loss.headline: Norway's Sovereign Wealth Fund Records $30 Billion Loss Amid Bond Turmoil
largest_wealth_fund_30b_loss.summary: The $2.3 trillion Norges Bank Investment Management reported a $30 billion third‑quarter loss as rising rates hurt its government‑bond holdings.
highlights: Fixed income portfolio returned –3.5%, driving overall downturn
Equities yielded only 0.5% while energy stocks outperformed

swf_china_hk_investments_190pct_jump.headline: Sovereign Wealth Funds Boost China and Hong Kong Investments by 190%
swf_china_hk_investments_190pct_jump.summary: Middle Eastern sovereign investors poured $14.2 billion into China and Hong Kong in 2026, reversing a previous year’s slump amid renewed confidence.
highlights: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund contributed $6 billion, while Abu Dhabi Investment Authority added $2.5 billion.
Gulf funds now represent nearly 70% of sovereign inflows to China and Hong Kong.
Investors target technology, biotechnology, consumer and advanced manufacturing sectors.

php_flaw_mass_outages.headline: Global PHP Flaws Trigger Millions of Hacks, Prompt Emergency Shutdowns
php_flaw_mass_outages.summary: Critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed led to millions of hacking attempts worldwide, forcing banks, airlines and governments to suspend services and rush patch deployments.
highlights: Cloudflare recorded millions of attack attempts within hours of disclosure
Japanese firms including Nomura and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group temporarily halted online services
Governments in Europe and Asia raised cybersecurity alerts and ordered inspections

php_flaw_hacking_attempts.headline: European Governments Pull Websites Offline Over Critical PHP Vulnerabilities
php_flaw_hacking_attempts.summary: Several European ministries and public institutions temporarily disabled their sites as a precaution after critical flaws were discovered in the widely used PHP programming language.
highlights: German IT service provider ITZBund and French Interior Ministry removed public sites pending patches
Dutch organizations including Port of Rotterdam and national football association KNVB preemptively shut down access
Wikimedia Foundation and Japan’s Ministry of Finance also suspended services to apply emergency security updates

dammam_riyadh_suspensions.headline: Biman Bangladesh Airlines Suspends Dhaka‑Dammam and Dhaka‑Riyadh Flights Amid Saudi Security Threats
dammam_riyadh_suspensions.summary: Biman has halted all Dhaka‑Dammam flights until 25 October and Dhaka‑Riyadh flights until 31 October after an attack on King Fahd International Airport, citing passenger safety.
highlights: Suspension covers flights scheduled for 23‑25 Oct to Dammam and all flights to Riyadh until 31 Oct
Flights to Jeddah and Medina continue as scheduled

openai_nears_up_to_30_billion_funding_ro.headline: OpenAI Targets $1.25 Trillion Valuation in $30 Billion Funding Round
openai_nears_up_to_30_billion_funding_ro.summary: OpenAI is seeking up to $30 billion from UAE investors and Coatue, aiming for a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of a potential 2027 IPO.
highlights: UAE investors lead the round, with Coatue also participating
OpenAI plans to spend roughly $600 billion on compute by 2030
The company filed a confidential prospectus with the SEC but has not set an IPO date

moderna_shares_plunge_after_leak_of_canc.headline: Moderna Shares Plunge 25% After Leak of Cancer Vaccine Data
moderna_shares_plunge_after_leak_of_canc.summary: Moderna’s stock fell 25% after a partial data leak revealed its personalized melanoma vaccine with Merck’s Keytruda cut recurrence risk by 42%, despite overall positive results.
highlights: The vaccine reduced distant metastasis or death by 38% versus Keytruda alone
82% of patients remained disease‑free at two years compared with 70% on Keytruda alone
Manufacturing takes six weeks, but Merck aims to shorten the timeline

comcast_beats_earnings_expectations_as_m.headline: Comcast Beats Earnings Forecast as Media Gains Offset Connectivity Weakness
comcast_beats_earnings_expectations_as_m.summary: Comcast posted $1.07 adjusted EPS, driven by strong Peacock performance and media revenue growth, while its connectivity segment saw declining broadband earnings.
highlights: Peacock earned $261 million EBITDA on $1.8 billion revenue, maintaining 48 million paid subscribers.
Comcast announced a spin‑off of NBCUniversal and Sky, targeting completion by mid‑2027.
Theme‑park revenue fell 4.4% to $2.6 billion, while mobile customers grew by 368,000.

japan_bd_investment.headline: Japan to Mobilize $6.35 Billion Private Investment in Bangladesh
japan_bd_investment.summary: Japan plans to arrange about 1 trillion yen in private-sector funding for Bangladesh over five years, targeting automotive, manufacturing and energy projects.
highlights: Japan aims to channel 1 trillion yen ($6.35 billion) into Bangladesh’s economy over the next five years
Investments will focus on automobile production, other manufacturing sectors and new energy facilities
Japanese firms, including Sumitomo Corporation, may enter Bangladesh’s Special Economic Zone

property_valuation_tax_evasion.headline: Bangladesh to Enforce Market‑Based Property Valuation to Halt Tax Evasion
property_valuation_tax_evasion.summary: The government will require all immovable property registrations to reflect actual market values, with committees assessing prices nationwide and revised taxes effective from July 2027.
highlights: Special committees at divisional, district and upazila levels will determine true market prices within four months.
Revised property registration fees and taxes are slated to commence on 1 July 2027.
CPD estimates the country loses about Tk6,000 crore annually due to undervalued registrations.

bangladeshi_nationals_injured_dammam.headline: Bangladeshi Nationals Injured in Attack on Saudi Dammam Airport, Embassy Visits Hospital
bangladeshi_nationals_injured_dammam.summary: Two Bangladeshis were wounded during the King Fahd International Airport assault in Dammam and are now receiving care at Saudi German Hospital, officials said.
highlights: The Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment confirmed the injuries and hospitalisation of the two nationals.
The victims, from Cumilla and Noakhali, lost consciousness from heat and smoke but sustained no physical injuries.
The attack is part of escalating strikes on Saudi infrastructure amid the Houthi‑Yemeni government conflict.

10yr_yield_drop.headline: 10‑Year Treasury Yield Falls Below 5% Amid AI and Oil Concerns
10yr_yield_drop.summary: Investors rushed to safe‑haven Treasurys as AI‑related bond issuance worries and rising oil prices drove a sharp sell‑off in equities, pushing the 10‑year yield to 4.972%.
highlights: 10‑year yield dropped 17 basis points to 4.972%, its first sub‑5% level since Sept. 23.
2‑year Treasury fell 16 basis points to 4.659%, reflecting short‑term Fed rate expectations.
Oil prices surged, with WTI up 2.39% to $99.47 per barrel, adding geopolitical risk.

sep_core_inflation.headline: Japan Core Inflation Hits 2.1% in September, Prompting Rate Hike Speculation
sep_core_inflation.summary: September core inflation rose to 2.1%, the highest this year, driven by weak yen‑linked import costs and rising durable‑goods prices, fueling BOJ rate‑hike expectations.
highlights: Headline inflation also stood at 2.1% while core‑core inflation reached 2.4%.
Nikkei 225 fell 1.62% as the yen strengthened to 156.15 per dollar.
Rice prices dropped 20.6% year‑on‑year, yet overall goods inflation rose to 2.8%.

chinese_offshore_shift.headline: Wealthy Chinese Shift Offshore Funds to U.S. Banks Amid New Tax Regime
chinese_offshore_shift.summary: As China imposes a 20% tax on overseas trusts, affluent Chinese are rapidly opening U.S. bank accounts to evade CRS reporting and reduce tax exposure.
highlights: U.S. banks are not subject to the OECD Common Reporting Standard, so they do not automatically share client data with Beijing
Chinese offshore trusts face a 20% retroactive tax, prompting transfers from Singapore and Hong Kong to U.S. institutions within
Large private banks attract wealthy clients, while regional banks and online brokers handle smaller accounts

bangladesh_japan_expect_to_sign_over_4_m.headline: Bangladesh and Japan to Sign Over Four MoUs During Prime Minister's Tokyo Visit
bangladesh_japan_expect_to_sign_over_4_m.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will discuss metro rail costs, loan rates and broader cooperation as Bangladesh seeks to deepen its strategic partnership with Japan.
highlights: More than four MoUs covering agriculture, fisheries, skills, aviation and trade are slated for signing.
Infrastructure financing, including Dhaka’s MRT Line‑1 and Line‑5 cost hikes, will be a key discussion topic.

climate_resilient_seeds_help_bangladesh_.headline: Climate‑Resilient Seeds Boost Bangladesh Rice Output Amid Shrinking Farmland
climate_resilient_seeds_help_bangladesh_.summary: Bangladesh increased rice production by 8% despite a 2% drop in cultivated area, thanks to climate‑resilient seed varieties raising yields by 10.3%.
highlights: Yield per acre rose 10.3% between FY21 and FY25.
New BRRI varieties enable rice cultivation in saline coastal Satkhira.

early_winter_vegetables_falling_fish_pri.headline: Early Winter Veggies and Falling Fish Prices Ease Dhaka Shoppers' Burden
early_winter_vegetables_falling_fish_pri.summary: As the Durga Puja holidays reduce demand, early winter vegetables and fish prices drop in Dhaka markets, while chicken, eggs and most groceries stay steady.
highlights: Bean prices fell to Tk140‑150 per kg, eggplant to Tk80 per kg.
Large ruhi fish price slipped to Tk350‑360 per kg amid weaker holiday demand.
Broiler chicken and eggs remained high at Tk180 per kg and Tk150 per dozen.

saab_orders_triple_after_ukraine_gripen_.headline: Saab’s Orders Triple on Gripen Deal with Ukraine, Boosting Earnings
saab_orders_triple_after_ukraine_gripen_.summary: Saab reported third‑quarter earnings beat expectations as new orders surged to 65.8 billion kronor, driven by a 24.6 billion kronor Gripen contract for Ukraine.
highlights: New orders rose to 65.8 billion kronor, more than triple last year.
Saab secured a 24.6 billion kronor contract for 16 Gripen E jets for Ukraine, deliveries 2029‑2030.
Order backlog reached 364.2 billion kronor, a sixth consecutive quarter of growth.

jensen_huang_visits_kazakhstan_for_ai_hu.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Visits Kazakhstan to Boost AI Hub Plans
jensen_huang_visits_kazakhstan_for_ai_hu.summary: Jensen Huang announced Kazakhstan’s $10 billion AI infrastructure drive, aiming to create a low‑cost data‑center hub for Europe using Nvidia GPUs and local talent.
highlights: Kazakhstan plans a 2‑gigawatt AI cluster in Ekibastuz with 300 MW now and up to 1 GW future capacity.
Firebird and Nvidia will co‑invest in building 100,000 advanced GPUs as part of the national AI priority.
German automaker Volkswagen entered Kazakhstan, leveraging its China factories to serve Central Asian markets.

sk_hynix_shares_rebound_after_scrapping_.headline: SK Hynix Shares Rebound After Halting Solidigm IPO Review
sk_hynix_shares_rebound_after_scrapping_.summary: SK Hynix stock rose 4.4% after the company scrapped its review of a U.S. IPO for subsidiary Solidigm, easing investor concerns over governance and funding.
highlights: Shares closed 4.4% higher, reversing earlier 3% losses
SK Hynix will explore alternative financing for Solidigm’s U.S. fab amid AI memory demand
South Korean regulators warned a dual listing could breach rules protecting minority shareholders

investment_scam_tk11cr.headline: Four Arrested in Bangladesh Tk11 Crore Online Investment Scam, Two Are Chinese Nationals
investment_scam_tk11cr.summary: Dhaka magistrate remanded four suspects, including two Chinese nationals, for allegedly embezzling Tk11 crore through promised high‑return online trading and block‑trade share schemes.
highlights: Police seized the suspects in separate raids in Adabor and Bashundhara Residential Area on 22 October.
Investigation revealed Tk8.92 crore transferred through one account and an additional Tk2.07 crore via other accounts.

commercial_terms_delay.headline: Meta pushes back commercial terms rollout amid publisher and advertiser backlash
commercial_terms_delay.summary: Meta Platforms delayed the start of its updated Commercial Terms and Self‑Serve Ad Terms to 20 November, citing the need to address concerns from publishers and digital advertisers.
highlights: Implementation date moved from 30 October to 20 November
Complaints were filed with EU and UK antitrust authorities over AI content usage rights

telco_spectrum_price_cuts.summary: Mobile operators argue that current spectrum renewal costs, double the global average, hinder network expansion and service quality, urging BTRC to lower fees.
highlights: Operators plan to renew 79.2 MHz of spectrum on 10 November, costing about Tk13,100.50 crore if cuts approved.
Spectrum charges represent 15.7% of operator revenue, versus a 7.7% global average.
Proposed 20‑year renewal term with equal annual instalments and no price revision.

lulafiscaltightrope.headline: Lula’s Re‑Election Sends Brazil Stock Index Plummeting Amid Fiscal Tightrope
lulafiscaltightrope.summary: Lula’s surprise win triggered a 13.9% Ibovespa drop, a near‑8% real slump and soaring bond yields as investors fear unsustainable fiscal expansion.
highlights: Brazil’s 10‑year bond yield rose 2.46 percentage points to its highest level in over a decade.
The Treasury cancelled two planned bond auctions amid demand concerns.

hondacanadatariffthreat.headline: Honda warns 50% Canada auto tariffs would cripple industry

highlights: Trump has threatened to double tariffs from 25% to 50% starting Jan. 1 if no new trade deal is reached
Honda and other manufacturers are urging a trilateral USMCA‑style agreement that includes Mexico to maintain competitiveness
U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer moved the USMCA into an annual review, ending its automatic 16‑year extension

bangaaicapital.headline: World Bank President Banga Says AI‑Driven Capital Demand Won’t Tighten Funding
bangaaicapital.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga affirmed that despite AI‑driven borrowing costs rising, $112 billion in capital remains accessible, especially for emerging‑market infrastructure projects.
highlights: The World Bank mobilized $112 billion last year, three times its level three years earlier.
Emerging markets focus AI investments on infrastructure such as bridges and roads, unlike developed economies targeting

janata_bank_uae_branch_closure.headline: Janata Bank Appeals for Govt Help as UAE Regulator Orders Branch Closures
janata_bank_uae_branch_closure.summary: Janata Bank’s board has urged Bangladesh’s government to intervene after the UAE central bank mandated winding down its four branches due to capital shortfall.
highlights: The CBUAE raised the minimum paid‑up capital for foreign banks to 400 million dirhams, far above Janata Bank’s 100 million
Janata Bank transferred 300 million dirhams to its New York nostro account, but the regulator did not recognise it as capital.

cable_market_shrinkage.headline: Bangladesh Cable Market Shrinks 25% Amid Demand Slump
cable_market_shrinkage.summary: Falling public infrastructure spending, a housing slowdown and high borrowing costs have cut Bangladesh’s cable industry revenue by about 25% in two years.
highlights: Market value fell from Tk12,000 crore in 2022 to roughly Tk8,000‑9,000 crore.
Over 100 manufacturers now compete for fewer orders, with many factories shutting and workers owed up to 30 months wages.

uniqlo_rmg_investment_urged.headline: PM Tarique Urges Uniqlo to Boost Investment in Bangladesh RMG
uniqlo_rmg_investment_urged.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman called on Uniqlo’s parent Fast Retailing to increase capital in Bangladesh’s garment sector, focusing on man‑made fibres, technical textiles and sustainable apparel.
highlights: Government will facilitate land allocation, investment approvals and administrative clearances for Uniqlo’s expansion
Both parties emphasized implementing the Bangladesh‑Japan Economic Partnership Agreement to deepen trade ties

houthi_missile_attack_on_ras_tanura_refi.headline: Oil Prices Rise After Houthi Missile Attack on Saudi Refinery
houthi_missile_attack_on_ras_tanura_refi.summary: Brent crude jumped to $115.59 and WTI to $101.37 as Houthi missile strikes on Ras Tanura sparked fears of prolonged Middle‑East supply disruptions.
highlights: Brent futures rose $1.50, up 1.32%, to $115.59 per barrel
WTI futures gained $1.47, up 1.47%, to $101.37 per barrel
Israel’s election stalemate adds to regional risk premium

boeing_shares_slide_after_disappointing_.headline: Boeing Shares Drop 10% After Disappointing Long‑Term Cash‑Flow Guidance
boeing_shares_slide_after_disappointing_.summary: Boeing reported a 4% revenue rise but warned that free cash flow will lag expectations through 2029, sending the stock down 10%.
highlights: Free cash flow forecast $3 billion for 2027 versus $5.7 billion consensus
Record $745 billion order backlog but production ramp to 52 jets per month delayed to late 2027
CEO Kelly Ortberg emphasized fuel‑efficient 737 Max appeal amid high jet‑fuel prices

robinhood_shares_fall_4_as_crypto_slump_.headline: Robinhood Shares Slip 4% Amid Crypto Revenue Decline
robinhood_shares_fall_4_as_crypto_slump_.summary: Robinhood reported a 4% after‑hours share drop as Q3 earnings missed forecasts, with crypto revenue plunging 55% despite growth in options and event contracts.
highlights: Earnings per share were 51 cents, below the 56‑cent consensus.
Transaction‑based revenue rose 19% to $867 million, driven by a 500% surge in event‑contract revenue.
Net deposits reached $15.7 billion, marking a 17% annualized increase.

power_grid_forms_5_member_probe_committe.headline: Power Grid Bangladesh Forms Probe Committee After 5,370MW Failure
power_grid_forms_5_member_probe_committe.summary: A five‑member probe committee was created to investigate the 5,370 MW grid collapse that cut gas and coal generation by up to 60 % across Dhaka and Chattogram.
highlights: Generation fell from 14,719 MW to 9,349 MW within one hour
Gas‑fired output dropped 60%, coal‑fired output dropped 39%
The probe committee, led by Syed Ebadullah Haider Ali, must report within five working days

pm_urges_japan_bank_for_international_co.headline: Bangladesh PM Urges JBIC to Open Dhaka Office for Investment Boost
pm_urges_japan_bank_for_international_co.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman asked Japan Bank for International Cooperation to establish a Dhaka office, aiming to deepen investment in Bangladesh's energy, ICT and infrastructure sectors.
highlights: JBIC Governor Kazuhiko Amakawa met the PM in Tokyo and said he will consider the office proposal
Bangladesh is reforming regulations to create a business‑friendly environment for foreign investors

indian_firm_l_t_wins_up_to_1b_dhaka_metr.headline: L&T Secures Up to $1 Billion for Dhaka Metro Rail Line 1
indian_firm_l_t_wins_up_to_1b_dhaka_metr.summary: Indian conglomerate Larsen & Toubro won contracts worth up to $1 billion to design and build key track, electrical and signalling packages for Bangladesh’s first underground metro line.
highlights: L&T will handle track works, electrical systems, signalling, telecommunications and platform screen doors for Line 1.
The contracts total about Tk 58,500 crore (~$1 billion) and are classified as a “major” order.
Funding for the metro projects comes from Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).

ai_integration.headline: Oracle Teams Up with OpenAI, Adds Google and OpenAI AI Chips
ai_integration.summary: Oracle announced expanded OpenAI collaboration, embedding ChatGPT and Codex in its apps while unveiling support for Google TPU and OpenAI’s Jalapeño AI chips on OCI.
highlights: Oracle observed GPT-6 Astra training at its Stargate data center in Texas
Cerebras chip deal boosts Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, with Cerebras stock up 8%

ai_policy_memo.headline: Amazon Warns Engineers Against Tokenmaxxing in New AI Guidelines
ai_policy_memo.summary: Amazon's internal memo urges engineers to use AI judiciously, discouraging tokenmaxxing and emphasizing long‑term outcomes over raw token counts.
highlights: Amazon shut down an internal leaderboard after detecting tokenmaxxing abuse
AI impact will be measured by feature velocity and long‑term outcomes rather than raw token usage
Engineers are encouraged to explain when AI tools do not add value to their tasks
